title: David’s Census and Judgment

questions.question: Who stood up against Israel and incited David to number Israel?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:1 (ESV): "Then Satan stood against Israel and incited David to number Israel."

questions.question: Who tried to dissuade David from numbering the people?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:3 (ESV): "But Joab said, 'May the LORD add to his people... Why does my lord the king seek this?...'"

questions.question: Which tribe did Joab not include in the numbering?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:6 (ESV): "But he did not include Levi and Benjamin in the numbering..."

questions.question: What message did God send to David through Gad the seer?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:10 (ESV): "Go and say to David... I offer you three things; choose one of them..."

questions.question: Which punishment did David choose?
options: Three days of the sword of the LORD (pestilence)
Three months of devastation by foes
questions.correctAnswer: Three days of the sword of the LORD (pestilence)
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:13 (ESV): "...let me fall into the hand of the LORD... but do not let me fall into the hand of man."

questions.question: Where did the angel of the LORD stand to destroy Jerusalem?
options: By the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite
questions.correctAnswer: By the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:15 (ESV): "...The angel of the LORD was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite."

questions.question: What did David see when he lifted his eyes?
options: The angel of the LORD standing between earth and heaven with a drawn sword
questions.correctAnswer: The angel of the LORD standing between earth and heaven with a drawn sword
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:16 (ESV): "...saw the angel of the LORD standing between earth and heaven, and in his hand a drawn sword..."

questions.question: How much did David pay Ornan for the site?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:25 (ESV): "So David gave Ornan 600 shekels of gold by weight for the site."

questions.question: Why did David not go before the tabernacle at Gibeon to inquire of God?
options: He was terrified of the sword of the angel of the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: He was terrified of the sword of the angel of the LORD
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:30 (ESV): "But David could not go before it... for he was terrified by the sword of the angel of the LORD."

questions.question: What did David say when he saw the angel striking the people?
options: Was it not I who gave command to number the people? It is I who have sinned... let your hand be against me
Why have you done this, Lord?
questions.correctAnswer: Was it not I who gave command to number the people? It is I who have sinned... let your hand be against me
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:17 (ESV): "...Was it not I who gave command to number the people? It is I who have sinned..."

questions.question: Who was with Ornan threshing wheat when the angel appeared?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:20 (ESV): "...His four sons who were with him hid themselves..."

questions.question: What instruments did Ornan give for the wood of the offering?
options: The threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen
questions.correctAnswer: The threshing sledges and the yokes of the oxen
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:23 (ESV): "...I give the oxen for burnt offerings and the threshing sledges for the wood..."

questions.question: How many men of Israel drew the sword according to the census?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:5 (ESV): "In all Israel there were 1,100,000 men who drew the sword..."

questions.question: How many men of Judah drew the sword?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:5 (ESV): "...and in Judah 470,000 who drew the sword."

questions.question: How did the Lord answer David from heaven?
options: With fire upon the altar of burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: With fire upon the altar of burnt offering
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 21:26 (ESV): "...and he answered him with fire from heaven upon the altar of burnt offering."

key_verse_text: David said to Gad, “I am in great distress. Let me fall into the hand of the LORD, for his mercy is very great, but do not let me fall into the hand of man.”
